subject: Private VPC readiness - follow-up & network asks
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@fintrack.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private VPC readiness - follow-up & network asks

Hi Elena — great to talk earlier today. Thanks for walking through FinTrack’s use case and expected volume. As discussed, you indicated a preference for a private VPC deployment (PrivateLink preferred) to meet data residency and network isolation requirements. To keep momentum, I captured the concrete items we need to qualify and hand off to network ops: 

- Preferred connectivity mode: PrivateLink (you mentioned) vs VPC peering — please confirm final preference.
- Customer CIDR(s) that will be used for the Redwood endpoints (example: 10.x.x.x/16).
- Egress expectations: Will FinTrack permit connections to a small set of Redwood egress IPs, or do you require an outbound NAT through your proxy?
- Allowed inbound ports and ports for PrivateLink (we typically use 443, plus optional health-check TCP).
- MTU and any IPS/IDS appliances that may terminate traffic.
- Firewall/ACL rules we should share with your network team.
- Expected concurrency/peak TPS and avg request size so we can size connection capacity.
- Compliance artifacts requested (SOC 2, encryption at rest, audit logs) — you mentioned SOC2 earlier.

I attached the network-reqs-template.xlsx — please have your network ops fill the highlighted fields and return. If helpful, we can schedule a 60-minute technical kickoff with our infra engineer Hiro to walk the template and confirm the PrivateLink flow. 

Next steps I propose:
1) FinTrack fills network-reqs-template.xlsx and returns it to netops@redwood.com by EOD Tue.
2) We schedule the 60-min technical kickoff (Hiro + Laura + your netops).
3) Once we have CIDRs and firewall rules, our SREs will produce the allowlist + prescriptive diagram.

Thanks — copying Laura and Monica to coordinate scheduling.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: network-reqs-template.xlsx (attached)
From: Elena Morris <elena@fintrack.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: FinTrack Network Ops <netops@fintrack.io>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private VPC readiness - follow-up & network asks

Thanks Karthik — excellent recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Connectivity: we prefer PrivateLink for this workload (avoids transitive routing through our peering fabric). Confirmed.
- CIDR(s): primary application subnet will be 10.50.0.0/16; we can reserve a /24 for the interface endpoints if needed.
- Egress: our security team will only allow outbound to specific IPs; please provide the egress IPs or FQDNs you expect to originate traffic from. We cannot open unrestricted outbound.
- Ports: 443 for app traffic, and TCP 2200 for active health checks if you need it.
- MTU: standard 1500 is fine.
- IPS/IDS: traffic passes through our perimeter IPS that will require TLS inspection; we will add exceptions for endpoint IPs if you provide them.
- Concurrency: initial pop is ~150 concurrent requests, bursting to ~500 during batch windows. Average request payload ~4KB.
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II in progress; we will still need Redwood’s SOC2 report and audit contact.

I attached a short doc listing known network constraints. Our network ops (netops@fintrack.io) will fill the template — copying them here. We have a change freeze the week of Nov 30, so earlier the better for the kickoff.

—Elena
Elena Morris | Director, Platform Engineering | FinTrack Inc.
elena@fintrack.io | +1 (617) 555-6283

Attachment: fintrack-network-constraints.pdf (attached)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Elena Morris <elena@fintrack.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, hiro_tanaka@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private VPC readiness - follow-up & network asks

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick details, that’s super helpful. A few clarifying notes and proposed plan: 

- PrivateLink accepted — we’ll design with an interface endpoint per AZ. Leaving a /24 is fine for the endpoint IPs.
- Egress IPs: we’ll provide a short-lived allowlist of egress IPs and FQDNs you can use for TLS exceptions; we also support peered-NAT arrangements if needed.
- Ports/healthchecks: we generally rely on 443 and occasional TCP probes. If you require TCP 2200 we can enable it on the health-check path.
- Concurrency: our network team recommends we reserve headroom for 2x your expected burst (so plan for 1000 concurrent).

I’ve attached a short reference file listing port ranges and PrivateLink port expectations — privatelink-ports-reference.txt.

Proposed next steps:
1) FinTrack netops fills network-reqs-template.xlsx and sends back (we can accept scan/pdf or native).
2) Technical kickoff: Hiro (infra) + Laura (solutions) + FinTrack netops — 60 minutes to review the template and diagram.
3) After kickoff we’ll provide: prescriptive allowlist, topology diagram, and a draft PrivateLink-runbook for your change window.

Scheduling options (Pacific): Mon 11/23 14:00-15:00, Tue 11/24 10:00-11:00, Wed 11/25 09:00-10:00. Please confirm availability and we’ll send a calendar invite.

—Laura

Subject: Re: Private VPC readiness - follow-up & network asks

Quick update and meeting confirmation — thanks all for the answers. Per the group, we’ll proceed with PrivateLink and the plan below: 

Action items (owners & ETA):
- FinTrack NetOps: complete network-reqs-template.xlsx and return by Tue 11/25 EOD (owner: netops@fintrack.io).
- Redwood (Laura/Hiro): produce prescriptive allowlist + PrivateLink diagram within 24 hours of receiving the template.
- Redwood (Security): share SOC2 report and point of contact (ETA 48 hours).
- Karthik: coordinate calendar and contract amendment if we need an SLA addendum (I’ll send the DocuSign link if requested).

Confirmed kickoff: Tue 11/24 10:00-11:00 PT (calendar invite to follow). I’ll include a short agenda: review filled template, confirm endpoint CIDR (/24), validate ports & healthcheck, and finalize timeline for change window.

If there are any blockers (firewall approvals, change freeze impacts) please flag them in-reply and we’ll escalate as needed. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Karthik
